proof_scope: propose-only fail-closed discipline and honest auth reporting

claims.proves: a scheduling write is proposed and never applied without --confirm, a confirmed write with no token fails closed, and status/events report honestly when unauthenticated
claims.does_not_prove: live OAuth consent, real calendar reads/writes, or event correctness (all require the human's Google OAuth client and token)

cases.name: reschedule-proposal-not-executed
command: ../run.sh propose-reschedule --event-id abc123 --to 2026-08-28T15:00:00-04:00 | jq -e '.schema=="ops_google_calendar.proposal.v1" and .status=="NOT_EXECUTED" and .confirmed==false' >/dev/null && echo PASS_PROPOSAL_NOT_EXECUTED

cases.name: confirmed-write-fails-closed-without-token
command: OPS_GCAL_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" ../run.sh propose-create --summary Sync --start 2026-08-28T15:00:00-04:00 --end 2026-08-28T15:30:00-04:00 --confirm; rc=$?; test $rc -eq 1 && echo PASS_WRITE_FAILS_CLOSED

cases.name: status-honest-when-unauthenticated
command: OPS_GCAL_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" ../run.sh status | jq -e '.schema=="ops_google_calendar.status.v1" and .authenticated==false and .status=="UNAUTHENTICATED" and .mocked==false' >/dev/null && echo PASS_STATUS_HONEST
